name: Malmstrom AFB
description: Home of the 341st Missile Wing. Malmstrom AFB operates Minuteman III intercontinental ballistic missiles across Montana and supports global strike operations.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

events.title: Home Alone Class
events.description: The Youth Center will be hosting a home alone class, which teaches youth about safety, and skills in handling emergencies, strangers, online risks, and basic first aid when unsupervised. The course builds self-confidence and independence to help the youth feel empowered when they are at home by themselves and allows parents to feel more secure when youth are alone. Registration closes for this event on Wednesday, September 14. Please sign up on the CYPBMS-Parent Portal. Cost: $12 Ages: 8-12

events.title: Living By Nature’s Calendar: Seasonal Living Practices
events.description: Wednesday, September 16 | 6 – 8 pm While Earth goes through seasons every year, our bodies respond differently to those seasons as we eat different foods, take in different amounts of sunlight, and experience different weather. Learn a few of the best practices to help your body adjust as the seasons change and what you can do to help keep yourself in optimal condition throughout the year. All you need to bring is a notebook, pen and curiosity! Register by Thursday, September 3 by calling 731-3359. Cost: $15 Ages: 18+

events.title: Pages and Plant Bingo
events.description: Bring all your bookish friends and plant-loving humans on down to the Grizzly Bend for some fun competition with a night of bingo. Participants will have six chances to win a variety of book and plant bundles that will include special editions, décor, and more! Pre-purchase of cards will begin at the Grizzly Bend on Monday, September 14 at 6:30 am and end Thursday, September 17 at 3 pm. Doors will open at 5:30 pm with the first game starting at 6 pm, and food and drinks will be available for purchase all night in the lounge. Cards will also be available for purchase at the event. Cost: $5 per

events.title: Hip Hop Bowling
events.description: Join us for a night of rhythm and rolls at our Hip-Hop & Bowling Night! Celebrate the vibrant energy of hip-hop while enjoying a fun-filled evening of bowling with friends. Show off your lyrical skills! We’ll have an open mic for anyone who wants to drop some bars between games. Cost: $22 per hour per lane (6 people per lane), shoe rental $3 Food Special: Buy one personal pizza and a soft drink, get one 50% off.

events.title: Leadership Night- Torch Club and Teen Council
events.description: Join this elite youth led event, where youth plan, design, implement, and create the vision for the club! Youth Leaders will deliver “9/11 letters” to local emergency responders. Registration closes for this event on Wednesday, September 16. Please sign up on the CYPBMS-Parent Portal . Cost: Free Ages: 9-12 and 13-18

events.title: Wellness Wednesday: Snack-N-Chat
events.description: Cost: Free Informal sit down with our MFLC. Children are welcome but supervision is not provided. Feel free to bring a snack and come chat! Please call the M&FRC at 731-4900 for more information. Location is Grizzly Bend.

events.title: Total Teen Takeover- Ramen & Dodge Ball
events.description: Back by popular demand, are the two favorites among teens! Join us at the youth center as we play dodge ball and enjoy fresh ramen together. You can invite a friend for this event too! The snack bar will be open. Registration closes for this event on Wednesday, September 23. Please sign up on the CYPBMS-Parent Portal. Cost: Free Ages: 13-18

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Malmstrom Inns and Suites (406-731-3394) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through Balfour Beatty Communities.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 341 FSS, M&FRC, and official Malmstrom sites for in-processing and missile operations support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
